description: For natural numbers \(x\) and \(d>0\), the constructed quotient and remainder satisfy \(x=dq(x,d)+r(x,d)\) and \(r(x,d)<d\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.division_spec (x d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
  x =
      d * Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.quotient x d +
        Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.remainder x d ∧
    Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.remainder x d < d
